title: Modular Input Deck
description: A customizable control deck for creative workflows and rapid hardware prototyping.
imageAlt: Modular input device with rotary controls and switches

content.heading: Designed to Be Modular
paragraphs: The input deck combines rotary controls, buttons, and sliders in interchangeable modules. This allows the interface to be adapted to different tasks.

content.heading: From Assembly to Interaction
paragraphs: The design considers assembly, cable routing, and tactile orientation from the outset. Cyan status indicators carry the portfolio's visual language into the physical product.
